entries.en: Nah, don't like this. How come she's not here yet? She said everything went fine...
entries.ro: Nah, nu-mi miroase a bine. De ce n-a ajuns încă? Zicea că totul a mers ca pe roate...

entries.en: Chill. If somethin' went wrong, they woulda come for us already.
entries.ro: Stai liniștit. Dacă ar fi mers ceva pe dos, ar fi venit deja după noi.

entries.en: Besides, she's one of the best. You know she zeroed that asshole from the board?
entries.ro: Plus că e una dintre cele mai bune. Știi că l-a lichidat pe jegosul ăla din board?

entries.en: Don't give a shit who she zeroed. If Brown gets word of this job, it's...
entries.ro: Mă doare-n cur cine a lichidat. Dacă Brown află de treaba asta, e fix...

entries.en: It's his word against ours. They can't prove a thing.
entries.ro: E cuvântul lui contra al nostru. Nu pot dovedi nimic.

entries.en: Even if they did, she wouldn't talk. Mercs who talk don't get gigs.
entries.ro: Chiar dacă au prins-o, n-ar zice nimic. Mercii care vorbesc nu mai primesc gig-uri.
